description: This file contains unit tests for the LuhnIdentifierValidator class, verifying the correctness of identifier validation and check digit computation within the context of OpenMRS's patient identifier validation logic.

classes.name: LuhnIdentifierValidatorTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of LuhnIdentifierValidator methods, including validation and generation of valid identifiers with check digits.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier_shouldGetValidIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that getValidIdentifier returns the expected identifier with correct check digit for valid input identifiers.

methods.name: getValidIdentifier_shouldFailWithInvalidIdentifiers
methods.description: Ensures that getValidIdentifier throws UnallowedIdentifierException when given invalid identifiers.

methods.name: shouldValidate
methods.description: Verifies the isValid method correctly handles valid and invalid identifiers, including those with the wrong check digit or malformed input.
